source_context:
Method: attention diffusing over a gene network (the multi-step walk).

A gene-by-gene dependence network. A query gene i (a black node labelled i) sits inside a loose module (its regulon, about a dozen genes joined by thin grey edges), with neighbouring modules around it. Attention is a unit of mass that starts entirely on i and spreads over the network like ink or heat diffusing through a graph.

Rule per step: every gene passes attention to its roughly 10 strongest partners with softmax weights (per-gene temperature, at most 50 candidate partners, no learned parameters), lazily: half of the mass stays put (P = 0.5 I + 0.5 A). The read-out is the symmetrised mass.

Main panel: a row of four small network snapshots of the SAME network (same node positions in each), labelled exactly 'step 0', 'step 1', 'step 3', 'step 9', joined by thin right-pointing arrows between snapshots. Step 0: only node i is filled solid magenta-pink (all mass on i), everything else white. Step 1: mass on i and its direct partners only. Step 3: mass covers most of the regulon, fading with distance. Step 9: mass spread through the whole regulon and thinning, faintly, into the neighbouring modules. Node fill = amount of attention mass: a single-hue magenta/pink (#e87ba4) ramp from white (none) to deep pink (much), plus a soft diffuse glow (heat/ink bloom) behind the nodes. Edges thin grey. No other colours inside the networks.

Second small panel (inset along the bottom or right), titled 'regulon (loose)' and 'complex (tight clique)' side by side, both at step 9. Left: a loose module (sparse web of nodes) completely and evenly tinted pink: mass covers it. Right: a tight clique (5 to 6 nodes all joined to each other, drawn as a pentagon with all chords, like a ribosome complex) sitting at the edge of a larger wider cloud of grey nodes (the wider translation program); pink mass leaks out of the clique into the surrounding nodes so the clique itself is only pale pink. A short curved arrow shows leaking mass. 

Style: clean, flat, vector-like scientific schematic, white / off-white background (#fcfcfb), thin lines, sans-serif text (Helvetica/Arial), dark grey text, minimal ink, like a Nature figure. Use only these labels: 'step 0', 'step 1', 'step 3', 'step 9', 'regulon (loose)', 'complex (tight clique)', node label 'i', and a small caption 'schematic' bottom-left. No numbers, no axes, no neural network imagery, no learned weights, no matrices, no other text.
communicative_intent: Attention diffusing over a gene network: multi-step lazy walk (steps 0, 1, 3, 9) and the loose-regulon versus tight-clique trade-off
